cases.name: test-fails-under-a-variant
cases.provenance: a new test that asserts the changed return value; scripts/revert-test-verify.py holds the exhaustive proof over fixture repositories; these two cases pin the accept and reject verdicts that check.sh gates on
cases.setup:
set -eu
git init -q
git config user.email t@t
git config user.name t
keep=$(mktemp -d)
cp cli/p/p.go "$keep/p.go"
cp cli/p/p_test.go "$keep/p_test.go"
printf 'package p\n\nfunc F() int {\n\treturn 1\n}\n' > cli/p/p.go
rm cli/p/p_test.go
git add -A
git -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -qm base
cp "$keep/p.go" cli/p/p.go
cp "$keep/p_test.go" cli/p/p_test.go
rm -rf "$keep"
